dir.description: Directory the four PNGs were written to.

files.description: `water_depth.png` (16-bit grey, depth / max_depth_m), `water_colour.png` (sRGB), `water_foam.png` (8-bit grey), `wave_normal.png` (tangent space, tileable), `wave_displacement.png` (16-bit RGB: east / up / north offsets at t = 0, `v / displacement_scale_m · 0.5 + 0.5`, tileable).

px.description: Depth / colour / foam map size, pixels.

max_depth_m.description: Deepest water, metres (the depth map's white point).

wave_tile_m.description: Wave tile side in metres and pixels.

waves.description: The wind sea that was baked.

tile_components.description: The components as snapped to the tile (wavelength and direction may differ slightly from `waves`).

displacement_scale_m.description: Metres per full channel swing of `wave_displacement.png` (the largest offset the sea reaches).

WaveSpectrum.description: The wind sea: bulk statistics plus the Gerstner components that draw it.

significant_height_m.description: Significant wave height Hs (mean of the highest third), m.

fully_developed.description: Whether the fetch was long enough for the sea to be fully developed for this wind.

breaking_depth_m.description: Depth (m) shallower than which waves of this height break (H/d = 0.78): the surf zone.

amplitude_m.description: Crest height above the mean surface, m.

direction_deg.description: Travel direction, degrees clockwise from north.
